title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Compute how much water can be trapped after raining using two pointers.

data.text: Given an elevation map, compute trapped water.
Approach 1: Prefix and Suffix Max Arrays
Precompute the highest wall to the left and right of every index. Water at `i` is `min(leftMax[i], rightMax[i]) - height[i]`. O(n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: Prefix/Suffix O(n)
O(n) O(1)

data.caption: Water at each index is bounded by the shorter of the highest walls to its left and right. The two-pointer approach moves the smaller side inward.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: Both are O(n) time. Prefix/suffix uses O(n) extra space for the two arrays. Two-pointer achieves O(1) space by moving the smaller side and tracking only the current max on each side.
